def count_column_carries(left, right, base=10):
    if any(type(x) is not int for x in (left,right,base)) or left<0 or right<0 or not 2<=base<=36:
        raise ValueError('invalid digit addition')
    left=int(float(left))
    right=int(float(right))
    result=carry=0
    while left or right:
        carry=int(left%base+right%base+carry>=base)
        result+=carry
        left//=base
        right//=base
    return result
